title: Green Candles Everywhere and the Future of Launchpads w/ PONS
summary: In this episode of Galaxy Grid, the hosts break down the latest crypto market surge as Bitcoin crosses $85,000 despite recent rate hikes. They analyze the fallout from the Clarity bill stalling, detailing the SEC's new five-year innovation exemption for the secondary trading of tokenized securities and the CFTC's protective guidance for passive software providers. Ozzy, founder of Pons, then joins the conversation to discuss building a token launchpad on Robinhood chain, the mechanics of creator rewards and onchain dividends, and the evolving landscape of social trading and meme stock culture.
